name: Static three-gain Chord with small h-only corrections
tagline: A fixed 0.01 gain on per-token corrections to the three-gain static Chord logits.
description: The h-only projection is zero at initialization. Every learned static control uses the peak LR of the static three-gain control, while the projection uses the native auxiliary AdamW rate.
mechanism: Fused position-only projection before the static control activations
Fixed projection gain 0.01 with separate peak learning rates for biases and gate weights
Saved-force static three-gain Chord geometry, attention VE and smear
limitations: Research run with matched random output projections and a high Chord learning rate.
